changes: Retires the legacy long-lived NewzDeckPicker.exe taskbar-fix launch because NewzDeck.exe has owned Windows taskbar identity since v3.6.5.
Makes Setup explicitly terminate stale NewzDeckPicker.exe, persistent NewzDeckThumb.exe, and NewzDeckYenc.exe helpers after the tray/service shutdown handoff and before Inno file replacement.
Future Update Center launches request Inno close/force-close behavior as a second layer of protection.
Adds Windows release smoke coverage that reproduces the real NewzDeckPicker.exe --taskbar-fix file lock and requires an installed upgrade to close and replace it.
Preserves the accepted v3.6.8 image-browsing performance and gallery-quality pipeline unchanged.
